title: 'Population up in 40 China-border villages': Amit Shah reaches out to Arunachal amid dam protests

ai.summary: Union home minister Amit Shah visited Arunachal Pradesh to address dam protests, stating population in 40 China-border villages has increased due to improved employment, healthcare, and other facilities, with the Centre directing military and border police to source produce from local cooperatives instead of cities.

facts.claim: population in 40 villages bordering China has increased
facts.quote: the population there has increased, and migration has stopped

facts.claim: improved employment, healthcare, and other facilities
facts.quote: Electricity, employment, and health facilities have been discussed. Water has also been delivered to the hilltops

facts.claim: Centre directed Army and ITBP to procure produce from local cooperatives
facts.quote: The Home Ministry has strictly mandated that the ITBP and the Army should not procure their produce from Tezpur or Guwahati; they must be procured from villages and cooperatives
